WITH net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) ns FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1
), rpt AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) rs FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.store_id, r.store_id) sid, m.ns, r.rs, m.ns - r.rs diff FROM mine m FULL JOIN rpt r ON r.store_id=m.store_id ORDER BY abs(coalesce(m.ns,0)-coalesce(r.rs,0)) DESC LIMIT 15

WITH net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), sales AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) net_sales FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1
), days AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, COUNT(*) trading_days
  FROM dim_store st
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28' AND d.is_trading_day
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
    AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.calendar_date)
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.calendar_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=st.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.net_sales / d.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(s.net_sales,2) net_sales, d.trading_days, ROUND(s.net_sales/d.trading_days,2) net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM sales s JOIN days d USING (store_id) JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank

SELECT store_id, count(DISTINCT business_date) days_with_rows, sum(CASE WHEN net_sales_before_returns<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) days_with_sales, min(business_date) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1 HAVING days_with_sales NOT IN (26)
